h: Confession time: I keep too many hits.
t: Every collector knows the feeling — you pull something beautiful and your first thought is "mine," not "list it." But a hit sitting in my binder isn't paying for the next hunt.

h: The Grails vault trick, plain and simple.
t: Pulls ride in the vault until you hit twenty-five cards. Then they ship home for five bucks flat — not free, five bucks flat for the whole stack.

h: Behind the curtain for a second: the store's photos are coming back, card by card.
t: Two thousand seven hundred and fifty-one listings rescued so far — front and back photos moved onto eBay's own hosting, verified by re-read, or nothing moves at all. It stopped…

h: Every card that comes in hits the same fork in the road.
t: Twenty bucks and up, or a dupe I already own? It goes to eBay. Small stuff, the fun cheap singles? Those feed the Whatnot piles for one-buck starts.

h: Mail day starts the same way every time.
t: Penny sleeve, rigid sleeve, team bag, mailer. Every card, no shortcuts. Up to ten cards ride in one mailer, and the mailer stays flexible so it moves through the machines like it…

h: Nobody tells you the real cost of learning FPV.
t: It is not the drone. It is the parts after the crashes.
